summary: Round 7 backend + wire-up certification for the driver-accepted branded email and AcceptanceInfo shared component. Created /app/backend/tests/test_final_qa_r7.py (8 tests). 7/8 pass. One HIGH-priority bug found: GET /api/driver/live/offers does NOT include transport_category or transport_description in the offer payload, so AcceptanceInfo on the driver Live popup silently skips the Transport Item + Description rows — one of the headline Round 7 deliverables. All other Round 7 items verified green: render_driver_booking_accepted subject/HTML/plain-text shape, email_log row on ASAP claim (template='driver_booking_accepted', status='skipped' as RESEND_API_KEY is unset in preview, user_id=driver_id), non-double-send on idempotent claim (exactly 1 email_log row), _finalise_paid_deposit wire for non-ASAP present + guarded by (not is_asap) AND fresh_booking.driver_id (source-inspection guard + direct-invocation smoke), recovery offer exposes vehicle_details (make/model/registration/condition) + vehicle_label. Regression: test_final_qa_r6.py 23/23, test_final_qa_r5..r2 46/46 — 100% green.

critical.issue: Offer payload is missing transport_category and transport_description. AcceptanceInfo on driver Live popup (live-offer-accept-<job_id>-transport-item / -description) will NOT render because these fields are absent. Fix: extend the offer dict at server.py:1766-1796 with `"transport_category": job.get("transport_category"), "transport_description": job.get("transport_description"), "recommended_vehicle": job.get("recommended_vehicle")` (last one is cosmetic — vehicle_label alias already works).

minor.issue: JobCreate model does not accept `recommended_vehicle` from the client; Pydantic silently drops it. Values in DB are set elsewhere (quote flow / admin edit). Tests must direct-write to Mongo to populate recommended_vehicle for offer testing. If the intent is for customers to submit the recommended vehicle at booking time, add the field to JobCreate.

ui_bugs.issue: Transport Item + Description rows will not render because the underlying /api/driver/live/offers response omits transport_category and transport_description. Component correctly returns null when fields are absent — the visible defect is missing data, not a component bug.

integration_issues.issue: Data contract between /driver/live/offers and AcceptanceInfo is broken for non-recovery ASAP jobs — fields exist in Mongo but are not projected into the offer payload.

action_items: Add transport_category, transport_description (and optionally recommended_vehicle) to the offer dict returned by /api/driver/live/offers (server.py ~L1766-1796). Re-run test_final_qa_r7.py::test_live_offers_exposes_acceptance_info_fields — must go green.
Consider adding `recommended_vehicle: Optional[str] = None` to the JobCreate Pydantic model so customers/admins can send it via /jobs POST rather than requiring a subsequent PATCH.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 5316 lines (already flagged in r6). Round 7 added ~50 lines to two large functions; splitting into modules is overdue but non-blocking.

send_driver_booking_accepted_email is called with a broad try/except in both wire sites (server.py:1897 and 2302) — good defensive coding, but the except swallows the traceback into logger.exception which is only visible in supervisor logs. Consider adding a Mongo audit row for the failure so ops can spot silent misses.

_finalise_paid_deposit ASAP guard uses `job_doc.get('service_timing') == 'asap'`. This is correct, but the same guard is not tested for a race where booking.driver_id is set BEFORE deposit finalise for a bidding ASAP (currently impossible — but if the flow changes, double-send risk returns). Adding an idempotency key on the email_log (unique index on (template, booking_id)) would eliminate the race for good.

success_rate.backend: 87.5% (7/8 new + 23/23 r6 + 46/46 r5-r2 regression). 1 new-test fail is a genuine bug, not a test defect.
success_rate.frontend: Not exercised via Playwright this round — code-inspection only. All 6 AcceptanceInfo mount sites verified in source: driver Jobs.jsx (L370), driver Live.jsx (L448 + photos strip L456-473), driver JobDetail.jsx (L169), driver BookingDetail.jsx (L396), customer BookingDetail.jsx (L466 + call-party-button gated by other_party.phone at L515), admin Bookings.jsx (L290). testId prefixes match spec.

test_credentials: Uses ephemeral TEST_qar7_* users created per-test via /auth/register. Admin fallback from /app/memory/test_credentials.md when needed.
seed_data_creation: test_final_qa_r7.py creates ephemeral TEST_qar7_ users + QAR7-* jobs + ephemeral bookings. Direct Mongo write to booking + job.recommended_vehicle bypasses Stripe. No shared state — each test is self-contained.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The only outstanding Round 7 fix is exposing transport_category + transport_description on /api/driver/live/offers. After that fix, test_live_offers_exposes_acceptance_info_fields will pass. The rest of the Round 7 deliverable is production-ready: driver-accepted email is wired at both call sites (ASAP claim + non-ASAP deposit-finalise), never double-fires, and writes an email_log row (status='skipped' in preview since RESEND_API_KEY is unset — that's expected). AcceptanceInfo is correctly mounted on all six screens with the right testId prefixes. Customer call-party-button is gated on other_party.phone (which the backend only populates post-assignment), so the pre-assignment hidden state is correct by construction.
rca of the issue: During Round 7 the AcceptanceInfo component was designed to read job.transport_category / job.transport_description directly from the job/offer object. It's correctly wired into driver Live.jsx to consume the offer object (`<AcceptanceInfo job={o} …>` at Live.jsx:448). However the /driver/live/offers response object built at server.py:1766-1796 only forwards a curated set of keys (title, category, service_type, vehicle_label, vehicle_details, photos, …) and DOES NOT include transport_category or transport_description. Result: AcceptanceInfo receives a job with those fields undefined and its `hasAny` guard causes the Transport Item + Description rows to be silently omitted on the driver Live popup — precisely the UX regression Round 7 was meant to eliminate. Fix is a two-line addition inside the offer dict literal.
